title: Fluoropolymer Tubing Industry Insights Report 2026: Total Revenue to Grow by $350 Million Reaching $1.13 Billion by 2032

description: The global fluoropolymer tubing market is projected to grow from $757.36 million in 2026 to $1.13 billion by 2032, at a CAGR of 6.85%. title: Global HVAC Filters Market Forecast to 2031 | Europe Emerges as a Fast-Growing HVAC Filters Market
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global HVAC filters market is projected to grow from USD 4.66 billion in 2026 to USD 6.21 billion by 2031, driven by increased demand for high-efficiency air filtration, stringent air quality regulations, and indoor air quality awareness. Europe emerges as the second-fastest-growing regional market.

title: Global Off-Highway Fluid Management Market Set to Reach $1.63 Billion by 2032, Driven by Increased Equipment Uptime Focus
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global off-highway fluid management market is projected to grow from $1.21 billion in 2026 to $1.63 billion by 2032 at a CAGR of 4.8%, driven by increased focus on equipment reliability, rental models, and OEM adoption of integrated system sourcing. Hydraulic systems remain dominant due to their high power density and critical role in heavy-duty applications. European markets are influenced by stringent environmental regulations and the transition to electric and hybrid machinery.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Identified as a key market leader implementing growth strategies including product launches, partnerships, and expansions in the expanding fluid management market.

title: Parker-Hannifin Buys $2.55B Flight-Critical Systems Business
author: Lekha Gupta
description: Parker-Hannifin (PH) announced a $2.55 billion acquisition of CIRCOR International's Commercial and Defense Aerospace business, owned by KKR. The deal is expected to close in H2 2026 and adds complementary flight-critical motion and flow control systems. Parker projects the business to generate $270 million in 2026 sales with margins above 40% before synergies, and expects the deal to be immediately accretive to EPS and cash flow. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is making a strategic acquisition that strengthens its portfolio with complementary capabilities, expects immediate accretion to EPS and cash flow, and raised full-year 2026 guidance above analyst estimates. The deal adds high-margin business with strong OEM exposure.

KKR is divesting CIRCOR's aerospace business, which represents a portfolio optimization move. No specific sentiment indicators are provided regarding the impact on KKR's overall performance or strategy.
